name: PostHog
tagline: Open source product analytics. Sessions, funnels, feature flags, A/B tests.
shortDescription: The all-in-one product analytics platform: events, funnels, cohorts, feature flags, A/B tests, session replay, and surveys. The open source Amplitude/Mixpanel/LaunchDarkly combo.
longDescription:
## What it is

PostHog bundles product analytics, feature flags, A/B testing, session replay, and surveys into one self-hostable platform. The OSS edition includes events, funnels, trends, cohorts, feature flags, experiments, and session replay (self-hosted).

## Why we recommend it

If you need Mixpanel + LaunchDarkly + Hotjar and don't want to pay 4 SaaS bills, PostHog is the open source answer. Self-host it, or use their generous cloud free tier (1M events/month).

## When to use it

- Replacing Mixpanel/Amplitude with self-hosting
- Adding feature flags without paying for LaunchDarkly
- Session replay to debug user issues
- A/B testing without Optimizely fees
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/PostHog/posthog
cd posthog/docker
docker compose up -d
```

**Cloud:** Free tier with 1M events/month. From $0.00031/event after.
